```{r, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(infer)
library(randomForest)
library(tidymodels)
library(modelr)
library(yardstick)
```


```{r}
# original analysis

load('~/Desktop/Pstat 197A/module1-biomarker-main-team13/data/biomarker-clean.RData')

test_fn <- function(.df){
  t_test(.df, 
         formula = level ~ group,
         order = c('ASD', 'TD'),
         alternative = 'two-sided',
         var.equal = F)
}

ttests_out <- biomarker_clean %>%
  select(-ados) %>%
  pivot_longer(-group, 
               names_to = 'protein', 
               values_to = 'level') %>%
  nest(data = c(level, group)) %>% 
  mutate(ttest = map(data, test_fn)) %>%
  unnest(ttest) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  mutate(m = n(),
         hm = log(m) + 1/(2*m) - digamma(1),
         rank = row_number(),
         p.adj = m*hm*p_value/rank)

proteins_s1 <- ttests_out %>%
  slice_min(p.adj, n = 10) %>%
  pull(protein)

predictors <- biomarker_clean %>%
  select(-c(group, ados))

response <- biomarker_clean %>% pull(group) %>% factor()

set.seed(101422)
rf_out <- randomForest(x = predictors, 
                       y = response, 
                       ntree = 1000, 
                       importance = T)

proteins_s2 <- rf_out$importance %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(protein = rownames(rf_out$importance)) %>%
  slice_max(MeanDecreaseGini, n = 10) %>%
  pull(protein)


proteins_sstar <- intersect(proteins_s1, proteins_s2)

biomarker_sstar <- biomarker_clean %>%
  select(group, any_of(proteins_sstar)) %>%
  mutate(class = (group == 'ASD')) %>%
  select(-group)

set.seed(101422)
biomarker_split <- biomarker_sstar %>%
  initial_split(prop = 0.8)

fit <- glm(class ~ ., 
           data = training(biomarker_split), 
           family = 'binomial')

class_metrics <- metric_set(sensitivity, 
                            specificity, 
                            accuracy,
                            roc_auc)

og_results <- testing(biomarker_split) %>%
  add_predictions(fit, type = 'response') %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class),
    predicted_class = factor(pred > 0.5)
  ) %>%
  class_metrics(estimate = predicted_class,
                truth = class, pred,
                event_level = 'second'
  )

og_results
```
sensitivity: 0.9375
specificity: 0.7333333
accuracy: 0.8387097
roc_auc: 0.8958333

```{r}
# fuzzy intersection

# takes only the (1-adjusted p-values) and protein names 
# makes into data frame
proteins_s11 <- ttests_out %>% 
  mutate(anti_pvalue = 1-p.adj) %>% 
  select(protein, anti_pvalue)

# keeps every MeanDecreaseGini importance value
proteins_s22 <- rf_out$importance %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(protein = rownames(rf_out$importance)) %>% 
  select(protein, MeanDecreaseGini)

# performs a fuzzy intersection 
# takes the average value of (1-p_value) and MeanDecreaseGini for each protein
# takes the top 10 proteins with the highest average values
proteins_sstar2 <- proteins_s11 %>% 
  inner_join(proteins_s22) %>% 
  mutate(avg = (anti_pvalue + MeanDecreaseGini)/2) %>%
  slice_max(avg, n = 10) %>%
  pull(protein)

biomarker_sstar <- biomarker_clean %>%
  select(group, any_of(proteins_sstar2)) %>%
  mutate(class = (group == 'ASD')) %>%
  select(-group)

set.seed(101422)
biomarker_split <- biomarker_sstar %>%
  initial_split(prop = 0.8)

fit <- glm(class ~ ., 
           data = training(biomarker_split), 
           family = 'binomial')

class_metrics <- metric_set(sensitivity, 
                            specificity, 
                            accuracy,
                            roc_auc)

fuzzy_results <- testing(biomarker_split) %>%
  add_predictions(fit, type = 'response') %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class),
    predicted_class = factor(pred > 0.5)
  ) %>%
  class_metrics(estimate = predicted_class,
                truth = class, pred,
                event_level = 'second'
  )

print(fuzzy_results)

data.frame(metric = og_results$.metric, 
           diff = fuzzy_results$.estimate - og_results$.estimate)


# Note that our diff column is (new - old)
# Our fuzzy intersection is performing significantly worse in sensitivity
# There is an almost .25 decrease in value
# On the other hand, our specificity is performing much better than our original
# Our specificity score went up by almost .2
# Our accuracy and roc_auc scores were not greatly impacted 
# Accuracy had a slight decrease of approximately 0.03 
# roc_auc had a slight increase of around 0.05
# We cannot conclusively say that this fuzzy intersection is better than the original
# It has both huge drawbacks and improvements 
# This version is more vulnerable to Type II errors
# It is less prone to Type I errors
```
sensitivity: 0.688
specificity: 0.933
accuracy: 0.806
roc_auc: 0.942

```{r}
# training and test data

set.seed(197)

subset <- sample(nrow(biomarker_clean), 110)

biomarker_train <- biomarker_clean[subset, ]

biomarker_test <- biomarker_clean[-subset, ]

ttests_out <- biomarker_train %>%
  select(-ados) %>%
  pivot_longer(-group, 
               names_to = 'protein', 
               values_to = 'level') %>%
  nest(data = c(level, group)) %>% 
  mutate(ttest = map(data, test_fn)) %>%
  unnest(ttest) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  mutate(m = n(),
         hm = log(m) + 1/(2*m) - digamma(1),
         rank = row_number(),
         p.adj = m*hm*p_value/rank)

proteins_s1 <- ttests_out %>%
  slice_min(p.adj, n = 10) %>%
  pull(protein)


predictors <- biomarker_train %>%
  select(-c(group, ados))

response <- biomarker_train %>% pull(group) %>% factor()

set.seed(101422)
rf_out <- randomForest(x = predictors, 
                       y = response, 
                       ntree = 1000, 
                       importance = T)

rf_out$confusion

proteins_s2 <- rf_out$importance %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(protein = rownames(rf_out$importance)) %>%
  slice_max(MeanDecreaseGini, n = 10) %>%
  pull(protein)


proteins_sstar <- intersect(proteins_s1, proteins_s2)

sstar <- function(df) {df %>%
  select(group, any_of(proteins_sstar)) %>%
  mutate(class = (group == 'ASD')) %>%
  select(-group)}

training_sstar <- sstar(biomarker_train)
testing_sstar <- sstar(biomarker_test)

fit <- glm(class ~ ., 
           data = training_sstar, 
           family = 'binomial')

class_metrics <- metric_set(sensitivity, 
                            specificity, 
                            accuracy,
                            roc_auc)


train_results <- testing_sstar %>%
  add_predictions(fit, type = 'response') %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class),
    predicted_class = factor(pred > 0.5)
  ) %>%
  class_metrics(estimate = predicted_class,
                truth = class, pred,
                event_level = 'second'
  )

print(train_results)

data.frame(metric = og_results$.metric, 
           diff =  train_results$.estimate - og_results$.estimate) 



# When we carry out the entire selection procedure on a training partition
# Every estimated value is significantly lower than our initial findings
# The smallest metric difference, specificity, is a decrease of approximately .09
# The largest metric decrease, sensitivity, is by approximately 0.39
# Overall, our new model performs worst than our original analysis
# However, it is important to note that our original analysis may have overfitted
```
sensitivity: 0.545
specificity: 0.636
accuracy: 0.591
roc_auc: 0.705


```{r}
# Changing numbers

set.seed(197)

ttests_out <- biomarker_clean %>%
  select(-ados) %>%
  pivot_longer(-group, 
               names_to = 'protein', 
               values_to = 'level') %>%
  nest(data = c(level, group)) %>% 
  mutate(ttest = map(data, test_fn)) %>%
  unnest(ttest) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  mutate(m = n(),
         hm = log(m) + 1/(2*m) - digamma(1),
         rank = row_number(),
         p.adj = m*hm*p_value/rank)

proteins_s1 <- ttests_out %>%
  slice_min(p.adj, n = 25) %>%
  pull(protein)



predictors <- biomarker_clean %>%
  select(-c(group, ados))

response <- biomarker_clean %>% pull(group) %>% factor()

set.seed(101422)
rf_out <- randomForest(x = predictors, 
                       y = response, 
                       ntree = 1000, 
                       importance = T)

rf_out$confusion

proteins_s2 <- rf_out$importance %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(protein = rownames(rf_out$importance)) %>%
  slice_max(MeanDecreaseGini, n = 25) %>%
  pull(protein)


proteins_sstar <- intersect(proteins_s1, proteins_s2)

biomarker_sstar <- biomarker_clean %>%
  select(group, any_of(proteins_sstar)) %>%
  mutate(class = (group == 'ASD')) %>%
  select(-group)

set.seed(101422)
biomarker_split <- biomarker_sstar %>%
  initial_split(prop = 0.8)

fit <- glm(class ~ ., 
           data = training(biomarker_split), 
           family = 'binomial')

class_metrics <- metric_set(sensitivity, 
                            specificity, 
                            accuracy,
                            roc_auc)

num_results <- testing(biomarker_split) %>%
  add_predictions(fit, type = 'response') %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class),
    predicted_class = factor(pred > 0.5)
  ) %>%
  class_metrics(estimate = predicted_class,
                truth = class, pred,
                event_level = 'second'
  )

print(num_results)

data.frame(metric = og_results$.metric, 
           diff = num_results$.estimate - og_results$.estimate)


# We changed the number of top predictive proteins using each selection method
# We changed it from 10 to 25 proteins.
# Our sensitivity and specificity scores were most impacted
# Sensitivity decreased by approximately .126
# Specificity increased by approximately .2
# Our accuracy and roc_auc scores both increased but not dramatically
# Accuracy and roc_auc increased by approximately .032 and .054, respectively
# Every metric except sensitivity increased
```
